task.summary: When fewer trains are returned than total_count reports, omit the 'no more trains today' sentence from the notice and keep only the incomplete-list warning.
acceptance: If the reported total exceeds the returned list, the notice warns that some trains may be missing.
In that case the notice does not claim there are no more trains today, even after the last departure.
If the returned list matches the reported total, the no-more-trains-today notice still appears after the last departure.
The count of trains in the output is unchanged by this fix.

data.message:
Don't say the day is over when Renfe's list is short

When Renfe reports more trains (total_count) than it returns, search() already
warns that some may be missing. It also added "No more trains today" once the
list was empty after the last departure. That claim is now left out when the
list is short; the warning stays. Full lists still get the notice. The number
of trains in the output is unchanged.

Tests: new test_no_more_trains_today_is_not_claimed_from_a_short_list (CLI,
checks exit code 0 and the exact notice), failing on the base source for the
short-list case and passing after the change. Full offline suite:
695 passed, 15 skipped, 1 failed: test_legacy.py::test_cli_search_falls_back_with_exit_0,
which passes --date 2026-11-20 and now hits the "in the past" usage check. That
test is outside this change and was not edited.

data.message:
Don't say no trains are left when Renfe's list came back short

When Renfe's reported total is larger than the list returned, search
keeps the "some may be missing" warning but no longer adds "No more
trains today after HH:MM" after the last departure, since the missing
trains may still be due. Lists matching the total still get that notice.

Added a CLI test in tests/test_search.py that runs today after the last
departure with a matching total (notice present) and a longer total
(warning only, no end-of-day notice); both check exit code 0. The new
test fails on the base source and passes with the fix.

which fails because the test's fixed date 2026-11-20 is now in the past).
